title: 第6章 强行补气丸第7章 高武世界
content_zh:
第241章 大结局
唐安蹲坐在自己的小床上，手里捧着【蜀山入门须知】，正飞快的翻着。
“这里说若要加入蜀山，成为外门弟子，第一条是年龄不得大于10岁。这点我完全符合。可是第二点，需要举起百斤石锁才能确定入门资格。当然，我的年纪比较小，可是起码需要举50斤才能确定资格啊。”
唐安看到这里就头痛了，他的身子很差，看着肥嘟嘟的可爱的很，可是根本没有多少力气。肉也多是浮肉，从小到大根本就没有怎么煅炼。他倒是想煅炼，可是他那副身体实在是吃不消。
他给自己做过测试，现阶段，他能举起的最多不过30斤。这点力气，实在是不够看啊……
“咦？这里还有一点。”
唐安慢慢往下看，只见上面还备注了一条。若是符合年龄要求，但是不具备举起重物的要求，那么可以交纳费用白银1000两，暂时加入蜀山，获得与其他弟子的同等条件。三个月后若是能够达到要求，依然可以转为正式的外门弟子。
看到这里，唐安顿时明悟：感情蜀山剑派还拿这种东西来赚钱啊！不过，蜀山剑派培养弟子的方法比较一般武林门派，肯定有过之而无不及。俗话说，穷文富武，能从小练武的人，想必也不会缺这千两白银。
无可奈何，唐安只能打算行那便宜之计了。
不过这事过于丢脸，还得从长计议……
九月九日，这一日乃是重阳。秋高气爽，万里无云，蜀山会馆之前人山人海，旌旗飞扬……
蜀山剑派专门派出了大量弟子来负责接待报名入派的小孩。
在那些弟子中，唐安还隐约看到了前几天被自家未婚妻从楼上给扔了出来的那个王公子。
王公子此刻一脸阴沉，想必对于前几天的事，还在耿耿于怀，看向所有人的眼神中都充满了阴厉。那些来报名的小孩一看到他的神『色』，全都离他远远的，谁都不敢靠近。
“要参加入门测试的请走这边！”
唐安听到不知道谁喊了一句，那些人都往一边走去，他也随着人流，朝会馆里前进。
沿着青石铺就的道路，众人行走了不过片刻，便来到一片空旷的场地。
这空旷的场地上，此刻已经聚集了上百个孩童了。这些人来参加蜀山剑派入门考核的，几乎都是男孩。毕竟加入蜀山剑派，都是来学功夫本事的。
女子，在这个年代，重要『性』明显就不如男子。何况，学武之人，需要身强力壮，女孩子在这方面先天便是弱势。
“想参加入门考试的，排好队，一个个到这里来测试！”一道浑厚的声音响起。

接着，唐安便看到一个雄壮的男子。那男子身形如铁塔一般厚实，站在那里就让人感觉到一股压抑。从远处看，那男子浑身都散发着一股气势！王公子就站在他旁边，可是任谁一看就知道，那王公子绝不是他的对手！
光看气势，便知道差距明显。若是真打起来，或许只要一招，那王公子就会败。
唐安听到这话，立马『插』进队伍，朝那中央靠近过去。
他现在虽然打定了主意，可是心中还是想试试，或许今天人品好，小宇宙爆发，举起了50斤的石锁。
毕竟千两银子可不是笔小数目，能省则省！
中央的空地上，摆放着大小不一的四个黑『色』石锁，上面还写着白『色』大字，分别是【50斤】【100斤】【200斤】【500斤】。
“能举起50斤的，便可以入门，可三个月后，必须举起100斤，才有资格成为我蜀山外门弟子！
能直接举起100斤的，便跳过三个月后的考核，只需要通过来年三月份的大考就可。
若是能直接举起200斤的，三年内不用参加大考，可以直接角逐内门弟子资格。
至于能举起500斤的，将有内门长老直接收入门墙，待验明身份，便可成为我蜀山内门亲传弟子，并且奖励黄金一千两！”
听到这里，顿时广场上一片哗然。
熟悉蜀山入门弟子规则的人，顿时都悄然议论起来。
“今年规矩怎么变了？以前可没有500斤这一条的。这世上能举起500斤的孩童可不多。500斤啊，那可是接近【天人第三重】的内气境界了。10岁的孩童，除非是绝顶天才，家族又肯浪费丹『药』，才能培养出这么一个小怪物吧？就算培养出来了，谁肯送到蜀山来？那不是为他人作了嫁衣裳吗？能培养出这样天才的家族和势力，全天下也没几个了。”
旁人听了只是笑笑：“谁说不是呢……我看这蜀山剑派，那真是一代不如一代了。居然想出这等办法来吸引天才。千两黄金？一个绝顶资质的孩童，那是能用钱来衡量的吗？”
“噤声！你不要命了，在这里说这些。我看你还是赶快走吧，免得我们都被你连累了。”
不管旁人怎么说，这些孩子来蜀山，那是打定了主意，一定要加入蜀山剑派，为家门争光的。
广场中央，有蜀山弟子维持秩序，一大群孩童排成了来回长队，一个个开始进行考核。唐安也在后面排着队，不停地给自己催眠，试图提升自己的肾上腺分泌激素，让自己小宇宙爆发一次。
”嘿！”
一名黝黑的健壮男孩，一声轻喝，猛的将那50斤的石锁轻松的举了起来。
“还举吗？”坐在一旁，持着『毛』笔书写的蜀山弟子淡然询问道。

那小胖墩摇摇头：“俺爹只让俺举50斤的。其他的没叫俺举，俺不举。俺要是举了，俺爹回去打俺屁股。”那蜀山弟子笑笑，将一块小牌子递给那小胖墩，又将他的名字记下。
“那，这是你的牌子！三日后，记得到这里来报道。”
那小胖墩接过后，高兴的哦了一下，飞一般的就朝自己的老爹方向跑去。可是刚跑到，他老爹就举起蒲扇大的手打他屁股。
“你这死孩子，缺心眼啊！明明在家里能举100斤的，为什么不举？我叫你缺心眼！我叫你缺心眼！”
他老爹一边喊着，那手一边还啪啪的朝那胖墩的屁股上招呼。那胖墩的脸都哭花了，可嘴里不求饶，只是涨红了脸道：“是你叫俺举50斤的。俺都举起来了，你还打我。我要告诉娘……”
唐安看了一会儿，心里越加着急。
因为有一大半的孩子都能举起50斤的石锁，还有少量几个能举100斤，至于200斤的。
至于举不起来的，到目前为止还没见到。可能是古代人比较内敛谦虚，举不起来未免太丢脸，所以都是有了极大的把握才会来参加考核的。
总之，唐安还没有看到通不过考核用银子开路的。
“难道我要开这个先例吗？这样可实在是太丢人了！”
转眼半个时辰便过去了……很快就轮到唐安了。
“咳咳……”
一声重重的咳嗽声从唐安的前面传出来。
唐安这才注意到，自己的前面还有一个瘦小的家伙。他的皮肤很苍白，从侧面看去，脸颊带着一丝病态的殷红，看起来身体比自己还差，这样瘦弱的家伙也来参加考核？
不过看到他咳的那么辛苦，旁边都没有人关心他一下，唐安不知道为什么心里忽然很难受。或许是从他身上看到了自己的影子吧。想想自己，若不是自己的身体里是一个20多岁的灵魂，怕是早该哭着喊着要找娘了吧。
想到这里，唐安便解开自己的腰间，那里有个葫芦，里面装着蜂蜜水。唐安喜欢吃甜的东西，小二知道这位小客官今天早上要去参加考核，天气怪热的，还特意给唐安准备了一壶蜂蜜水。
唐安杵了杵那人的肩膀，真诚道：“喝点蜂蜜水吧。”
那人回过头来，看了唐安一眼，看到他递过来一个小葫芦，已经开了盖子，里面正散发着蜂蜜特有的清香。
看到唐安清澈的眼神里带着丝丝关心，那人的心里不觉间也有些温暖。
那人接过葫芦，轻轻对着嘴巴喝了一口。蜂蜜水治疗咳嗽有多大效果，唐安可不知道，只是他看到对方喝了一口，咳嗽轻了不少，心里高兴能帮到对方，脸上也『露』出笑容：“你若是喜欢，多喝一点也没关系的。”

那人摇摇头，又将葫芦递回来：“谢谢你，够了。”
声音很轻柔，眼睛大大的，带水，像一汪湖水，惹人怜爱。
唐安不由得睁大了眼睛，看着那人：“你是女孩？”
那个小姑娘听到这话，眉头一皱，显得很不高兴，就直接转过脑袋去，不再同唐安说话了。
唐安觉得无趣，自己拿过葫芦狠狠喝了一口。『奶』『奶』的，这么快就轮到我了，我还没想到办法呢。难不成真用银子填？
很快前面便没人了，轮到了唐安身前的那个小女孩。
唐安仔细看着她一步步坚定的走过去。她的背影很倔强，挺的笔直，似曾相识。虽然她的身子那么弱小，可是任谁都能看出她内心里的坚毅。唐安在后头忍不住喊了一声：“加油啊！”
那个女孩愕然的回过头来，看到是刚才那个小胖子喊的，脸上浮现了一丝笑容，轻轻点了点头。
她跳过第一个石锁，直接走到了第二个100斤的石锁上，可是眼睛却犹豫的看了200斤的石锁一眼。
她捏住了100斤的石锁，嘴里娇喝一声，“嘿！”
她的身体看起来是那么弱小，但是她却出乎所有人的意料，轻而易举的将100斤的石锁举过了头顶。她骄傲的转过身来，看着围在四周的，那些已经通过了考核的男孩子们。看到他们满脸惊讶的样子，她仰着脑袋，将石锁重重的往地上一扔，骄傲的又回过身去。
她似乎是在说明一件事：“谁说女子不能练功！”
“通过！100斤石锁！”
她领了牌子，又报了姓名，却没有朝旁边退开，而是直接朝唐安走了过来。她飞快的把一个小东西塞到唐安的手里，然后在唐安的耳边清楚的说道：“吃下去，小胖子！”
唐安疑『惑』的看了手上一眼，居然是一颗白『色』的小『药』丸。
【叮~系统提示：获得强行补气丸一枚，食用后，在10分钟时间里力气双倍。过后会全身无力。属于毒『药』，请注意！限制：只能使用一次，下次使用直接判定无效！】
唐安听到这里，嘴角顿时咧开了。
他吧唧一口，毫不犹豫的便将这颗小『药』丸吃到了肚子里，然后转过头去，对着一边的那个小女孩重重的拍了拍自己肉嘟嘟的小胸脯，表示我没问题，然后雄赳赳气昂昂的大步走到了那个50斤的石锁面前，在所有人的眼神注目下，“嗖”的一下，将那最轻的50斤的石锁，轻松的给举了起来！
而那个原本一脸笑意看着他的小姑娘，忽然脸上僵了一下，随即，她的眼皮子便开始猛跳。
“这个小胖子该不会连50斤的力气都没有，就来参加考核吧？”
content_en:
Chapter 241 Finale
Tang An was squatting on his little bed, holding [Instructions for Getting Started with Shushan] in his hand and flipping through it quickly.
"It says here that if you want to join Shushan and become an outer disciple, the first rule is that you must be no older than 10 years old. I completely comply with this point. But the second point is that you need to lift a hundred kilograms of stone locks to determine the qualifications. Of course, I am relatively young, but I need to lift at least 50 kilograms to confirm the qualifications."
Tang An had a headache when he saw this. He was in poor health and looked chubby and cute, but he didn't have much strength at all. The meat is mostly floating meat, and it has not been tempered at all since I was a child. He wanted to exercise, but his body couldn't bear it.
He has done tests on himself. At this stage, the most he can lift is 30 kilograms. This little strength is really not enough...
"Huh? There's a little more here."
Tang An slowly looked down and saw a note on it. If you meet the age requirement but do not meet the requirements for lifting heavy objects, you can pay a fee of 1,000 taels of silver to temporarily join Shushan and obtain the same conditions as other disciples. If you can meet the requirements after three months, you can still become an official outer disciple.
Seeing this, Tang An suddenly understood: The Shushan Sword Sect still uses this kind of thing to make money! However, the Shushan Sword Sect's method of cultivating disciples is definitely better than that of other martial arts sects. As the saying goes, if you are poor in literature and rich in martial arts, and you can practice martial arts since childhood, you will definitely not be short of this thousand taels of silver.
There was no choice but to take advantage of Tang An's plan.
However, this matter is too embarrassing and needs to be considered in the long term...
September 9th is the Double Ninth Festival. The autumn air is crisp and cloudless. There is a sea of people in front of the Shushan Guild Hall, and flags are flying...
The Shushan Sword Sect specially sent a large number of disciples to receive the children who signed up to join the sect.
Among those disciples, Tang An also vaguely saw the prince who was thrown out of the building by his fiancée a few days ago.
Prince Wang had a gloomy look on his face at the moment. He must be still brooding about what happened a few days ago, and his eyes were full of sternness when he looked at everyone. As soon as the children who came to sign up saw his expression, they all stayed away from him, and no one dared to approach him.
"If you want to take the entry test, please go this way!"
Tang An heard someone shout, and those people walked aside. He also followed the flow of people and headed towards the guild hall.
Following the road paved with bluestones, everyone walked for only a moment before arriving at an open field.
At this moment, hundreds of children have gathered in this empty field. Almost all of these people who came to take the entrance examination of Shushan Sword Sect were boys. After all, joining the Shushan Sword Sect is all about learning kung fu skills.
For women, in this era, sex is obviously not as important as men. What's more, those who want to learn martial arts need to be physically strong, and girls are inherently weak in this regard.
"Those who want to take the entrance exam, please line up and come here to take the test one by one!" A deep voice sounded.
Then, Tang An saw a majestic man. The man's body was as thick as an iron tower, and standing there made people feel depressed. From a distance, the man exuded an aura of aura! The prince is standing next to him, but anyone can tell at a glance that the prince is no match for him!
Just looking at the momentum, you can tell that the gap is obvious. If there was a real fight, perhaps with just one move, the prince would be defeated.
When Tang An heard this, he immediately joined the team and approached the center.
Although he has made up his mind now, he still wants to give it a try. Maybe if he is a good character today, the small universe will explode and lift a 50-pound stone lock.
After all, a thousand taels of silver is not a small sum of money, so save it if you can!
In the open space in the center, there are four black stone locks of different sizes, with large white characters written on them, which read "50 Jin".【100 jins】【200 jins】【500 jins】.
"Those who can lift 50 kilograms can get started, but after three months, they must lift 100 kilograms to be qualified to become my Shushan outer sect disciple!
Those who can directly lift 100 kilograms will skip the assessment three months later and only need to pass the major exam in March of the following year.
If you can directly lift 200 kilograms, you do not need to take the major exam within three years and can directly compete for the qualification of an inner disciple.
As for those who can lift 500 kilograms, the elders of the inner sect will be put directly into the door wall. Once their identities are verified, they can become my direct disciples of the inner sect of Shushan and be rewarded with one thousand taels of gold! "
Hearing this, there was an uproar in the square.
People who were familiar with the rules of Shushan's entry-level disciples immediately started talking quietly.
"Why did the rules change this year? There was no such thing as 500 kilograms before. There are not many children in the world who can lift 500 kilograms. 500 kilograms, that is close to the [third level of heaven and man] inner energy realm. A 10-year-old child, unless he is an extremely talented person , The family is willing to waste elixirs to cultivate such a little monster, right? Even if it is cultivated, who is willing to send it to Shushan? Isn't it a wedding dress for others? There are not many families and forces in the world that can cultivate such a genius."
The others just smiled after hearing this: "Who says it's not the case... I think this Shushan Sword Sect is really getting worse from generation to generation. It actually came up with such a way to attract geniuses. A thousand taels of gold? Can a child with extremely high qualifications be measured by money?"
"Silence! You don't want your life to say this here. I think you should leave quickly, lest we all be implicated by you."
No matter what others say, these children came to Shushan with their determination to join the Shushan Sword Sect and bring honor to their family.
In the center of the square, there were Shushan disciples maintaining order. A large group of children lined up in a long queue and began to take assessments one by one. Tang An was also queuing up behind him, constantly hypnotizing himself, trying to increase his adrenaline secretion hormones and make his small universe explode.
"Hey!"
A dark, muscular boy shouted softly and lifted up the 50-pound stone lock with ease.
"Do you still want to raise it?" The Shushan disciple sitting aside and writing with a brush asked calmly.
The little fat man shook his head: "My father only asked me to lift 50 kilograms. If I'm not asked to lift anything else, I won't lift. If I lift it, my father will go back and spank me." The Shushan disciple smiled, handed a small sign to the little fat man, and wrote down his name.
"Then, this is your sign! Remember to report here in three days."
After the little fat man took it, he felt happy and ran towards his father as fast as he could. But as soon as he got there, his father raised his hand as big as a cattail leaf fan and spanked him.
"You damn kid, you are so heartless! You can obviously lift 100 kilograms at home, why can't you lift it? I call you a heartless person! I call you a heartless person!"
While his father was shouting, he slapped his hand on the fat ass. The fat man's face was wet with tears, but he didn't beg for mercy. He just blushed and said, "You asked me to lift 50 pounds. I even lifted it, and you hit me. I want to tell mother..."
Tang An watched for a while, feeling increasingly anxious.
Because more than half of the children can lift a 50-jin stone lock, and a few can lift 100 kilograms, and even 200 kilograms.
As for those that can’t be lifted, I haven’t seen one so far. Maybe it's because people in ancient times were more restrained and modest, and it would be too embarrassing to be unable to lift it, so they only came to take part in the assessment when they were extremely confident.
In short, Tang An has never seen anyone who failed the test use money to open a path.
"Do I want to set this precedent? This is really embarrassing!"
Half an hour passed in the blink of an eye... Soon it was Tang An's turn.
"Ahem..."
oneA heavy coughing sound came from in front of Tang An.
Only then did Tang An notice that there was a thin guy in front of him. His skin was very pale, and when viewed from the side, his cheeks had a sickly red color. He seemed to be in worse shape than himself. How could such a thin guy take part in the assessment?
But seeing that he was coughing so hard and no one around him cared about him, Tang An didn't know why he suddenly felt very uncomfortable. Maybe he saw his own reflection in him. Think about yourself, if you didn't have a 20-year-old soul in your body, I would have been crying and looking for a mother.
Thinking of this, Tang An untied his waist. There was a gourd containing honey water. Tang An likes to eat sweet things. The waiter knew that the young guest officer was going to take an exam this morning and the weather was extremely hot, so he specially prepared a pot of honey water for Tang An.
Tang An pinched the man's shoulder and said sincerely: "Drink some honey water."
The man turned around, glanced at Tang An, and saw him handing over a small gourd. The lid had been opened, and the unique fragrance of honey was exuding from inside.
Seeing the trace of concern in Tang An's clear eyes, the man felt a little warm in his heart.
The man took the gourd and took a sip. Tang An didn't know how effective honey water was in treating coughs, but he saw the other person took a sip and his cough became much lighter. He was happy to be able to help the other person, and a smile appeared on his face: "If you like it, it doesn't matter if you drink more."
The man shook his head and handed the gourd back: "Thank you, that's enough."
The voice is very soft, and the eyes are big and watery, like a lake, which is endearing.
Tang An couldn't help but open his eyes wide and looked at the person: "Are you a girl?"
When the little girl heard this, she frowned and looked very unhappy. She turned her head away and stopped talking to Tang An.
Tang An found it boring, so he took the gourd and took a sip. Damn it, it's my turn so soon, I haven't thought of a way yet. Is it possible to really fill it with money?
Soon there was no one in front, and it was the turn of the little girl in front of Tang An.
Tang An watched carefully as she walked over step by step. Her back was very stubborn and straight, and she looked familiar. Although her body is so weak, anyone can see the perseverance in her heart. Tang An couldn't help shouting from behind: "Come on!"
The girl turned around in shock and saw that it was the little fat man who had shouted just now. A smile appeared on her face and she nodded lightly.
She skipped the first stone lock and walked directly to the second 100-pound stone lock, but her eyes hesitantly glanced at the 200-pound stone lock.
She pinched the 100-pound stone lock and shouted, "Hey!"
Her body looked so weak, but she exceeded everyone's expectations and easily lifted the 100-pound stone lock above her head. She turned around proudly and looked at the boys surrounding her who had passed the examination. Seeing the surprised looks on their faces, she raised her head, threw the stone lock heavily to the ground, and turned back proudly.
